messages:
Alex K: quick update from procurement — SuperCompute notified us this morning: 8/12 H100 units are cleared, 4 still on customs hold. ETA for full lot moved from 2026-03-24 to 2026-03-28. doing follow-up with customs broker now. :frowning:

Priya M: thanks. can you confirm serials and whether the cleared ones include the spares we ordered? need to update capacity reservation slate for customers.

Alex K: cleared units = serials H100-SC-1001..1008 (includes 2 spares). will push manifest in a sec.

Mateo R: rack/power update: we finished PDUs and high-current feeds at primary DC for 16 GPUs per rack. can accept first 8 H100s for staging tomorrow. network patch (MTU tuning for RDMA) scheduled 03/25 02:00-03:00 UTC.

Jing Li: nice — software side: image with CUDA 12.2 and NCCL 2.18 baked. need driver 545.xx — is that what vendor shipped? if customs delays force us to use A100s in some racks we need a fallback image (NCCL 2.15).

Alex K: vendor manifest attached: 
```
H100-SC-1001 H100 80GB 545.35
H100-SC-1002 H100 80GB 545.35
H100-SC-1003 H100 80GB 545.35
H100-SC-1004 H100 80GB 545.35
H100-SC-1005 H100 80GB 545.35
H100-SC-1006 H100 80GB 545.35
H100-SC-1007 H100 80GB 545.35
H100-SC-1008 H100 80GB 545.35
H100-SC-1009 H100 80GB (held)
H100-SC-1010 H100 80GB (held)
H100-SC-1011 H100 80GB (held)
H100-SC-1012 H100 80GB (held)
```

Priya M: OK — action items: (1) Mateo to provision 8 GPU slots for staging and mark 8 as reserved for Dedicated onboarding next week; (2) Alex to confirm customs ETA by EOD and update the sales/reservations doc; (3) Jing to prepare fallback A100 image and smoke tests.

Mateo R: will provision 8 slots tomorrow and tag them `dedicated-onboarding/2026-03-26`. will also leave 4 empty slots until we have full lot.

Jing Li: on it — will push A100 fallback image to staging registry and add a small smoke test that runs a short allreduce. PR: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/images/pulls/438

Sarah (ops): heads-up — sales already started promising early April capacity to two customers (acct-42, acct-77). if full shipment slips past 03/28 we need an official delay notice and updated reservation credits. Alex — can you confirm which customers will be bumped?

Alex K: I'm pulling the reservation sheet now. draft msg for sales ops: "Partial delivery allows limited onboarding this week (8 GPUs). Full fleet expected 2026-03-28; we will prioritize acct-42 then acct-77. If customs delays > 48h we will offer 10% credit on first month." put in #sales-ops for approval?

Priya M: yes please. also flag on console that the Dedicated capacity calendar shows 8 GPUs available from 2026-03-26, rest from 2026-03-28 (tentative).

deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/staging/provisioning -> start at 2026-03-25T02:10Z (job #2247).

Mateo R: note for on-call: if the customs release happens after we start the network patch window, we should delay patch by 2h to avoid disrupting staging moves. I'll coordinate with SRE.

Jing Li: +1 to delay if needed. also need explicit driver package in the deployment ticket. I'll add `nvidia-driver-545.35.run` to the PR.

Alex K: timeline summary (tentative):
- 2026-03-25: staging image builds + network patch (if no hold)
- 2026-03-26: receive 8 H100 -> provision and onboard first Dedicated customers
- 2026-03-28: expected full delivery of remaining 4 H100s -> complete capacity reservations

Sarah (ops): perfect. can someone paste the final reservation changes into the shared spreadsheet when you provision? I'll prepare the customer comms template and run it by legal. :white_check_mark:

Priya M: will follow up with a short thread in #sales-ops after Alex posts the confirmed serials. thanks all.
